packageRules.description: qBittorrent (LinuxServer): track only the clean X.Y.Z app-version tag. The regex versioning drops the 5.2.3_v2.0.14-lsNNN / -libtorrentv1 variants; allowedVersions drops the ancient 20.04.x Ubuntu-scheme tags (raise the major cap if qBittorrent ever reaches v10).
AutoBangumi: SemVer, so beta tags are ignored
Hermes: releases moved from CalVer (v2026.9.24) to SemVer (v0.22.0). The old CalVer tags still exist and sort above every v0.x tag, so ignore them.
Group the caddy base image bumps into one PR

Patch updates merge straight to main with no PR, once the release is 3 days old (time for a bad release to be pulled). There is no CI to wait for, hence ignoreTests. The host's deploy/ timer then rolls them out. Minor and major updates still open PRs.
